license_required.quote: no person shall practice, offer to practice, advertise, or announce oneself, either publicly or privately, as prepared or qualified to practice podiatric medicine, either gratuitously or for pay

issuing_authority.quote: without having a valid unrevoked license obtained from the Hawaii medical board, as prescribed in this chapter

degree_required.quote: The applicant is a graduate in podiatric medicine of a college approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association and by the Hawaii medical board

accrediting_body.quote: a college approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association and by the Hawaii medical board

required.quote: The applicant has completed at least twenty-four months in an accredited podiatric residency, as approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education, prior to applying for licensure

duration.quote: completed at least twenty-four months in an accredited podiatric residency

kind.quote: twenty-four months in an accredited podiatric residency, as approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

exams.notes: Written examinations covering basic sciences, clinical sciences, and clinical competency
exams.quote: the applicant has passed written examinations covering basic sciences, clinical sciences, and clinical competency as administered by the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners or its successor organization

interval_years.quote: Every person holding a license under this chapter shall renew the license with the board no later than January 31 of each even-numbered year

required.quote: pay a renewal fee, and comply with the continuing education requirements provided in rules adopted by the board

definition_quote.value: the medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical diagnosis and treatment of the human foot, malleoli, and ankle, including the surgical treatment of the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot, but does not include amputation above the ankle, treatment of systemic conditions, or the use of any anesthetic except local anesthetic
